title: Open Diffusion Spec (ODS) 2.0.0
description: A machine-readable description of an artifact and its diffusion state. ODS is a public protocol: it is owned by nobody, implementable by anybody, and every field that carries a judgement must carry its evidence basis. Fields are additive across minor versions; see schema-versioning.md.

$comment: ODS 2.0.0. Breaking change from 1.0.0: the Attempt Quality Index moved from 20 to 25 dimensions, so the dimension key enum changed and every weight changed. A 1.x document is migrated, never silently re-scored — see protocol/schema-versioning.md and `viral-engine migrate`.

^x_[a-z0-9_]+$.description: A namespaced extension. Allowed by schema-versioning.md rule 1: it must not be required for the document to validate, must not change the meaning of an ODS field, and must not contain personal data about third parties. Implementations must ignore keys they do not know.
